item.title: First Lady Melania Trump’s Special Visit to Ashe County, North Carolina Bearing Witness to a Community’s Resilience
item.description:
Office of the First LadyFirst Lady Melania Trump’s Special Visit to Ashe County, North Carolina Bearing Witness to a Community’s ResilienceThe White HouseSeptember 15, 2026

First Lady Melania Trump returned to North Carolina to visit Mountain View Elementary School in Ashe County, nearly two years after her initial visit to a community devastated by Hurricane Helene.
“True resilience means having the courage to look ahead and move society forward, creating a better future,” the First Lady said.
This visit shared a different story: one of resilience and a community determined to move forward. Mrs. Trump’s return denoted a new chapter in the western North Carolina regional recovery. Her first visit came in the immediate aftermath of the disaster, when the focus was on comforting survivors, thanking first responders, and confronting the extraordinary destruction left behind.
Mrs. Trump highlighted the forward-looking spirit of North Carolinians affected by Hurricane Helene, and their accelerated journey to the forefront of artificial intelligence technology.
Joining the First Lady at Mountain View Elementary was Carrie Robledo, a North Carolina second-grade teacher and 2026 Presidential AI Challenge National Champion. Mrs. Trump praised Ms. Robledo’s innovative work introducing young students to artificial intelligence.
“Ms. Robledo built something that no hurricane can destroy, and no flood can wash away: knowledge. And knowledge is power,” the First Lady said.
First Lady Melania Trump’s inaugural Presidential AI Challenge became the most expansive federally led artificial intelligence competition in American history, engaging more than 20,000 participants from all 50 states.
“That is the lasting spirit of America. We may face hard times, but we do not fail. We choose to grow—like a rare young flower pushing through the cold earth after a storm,” said the First Lady—celebrating the strength of a community that did not want to be defined by disaster and reflecting on Ashe County’s recovery.
Finally, The First Lady delighted students, teachers, and administrators with a special gift. BE BEST Fostering the Future, NVIDIA, and StudyFetch gifted 1,500 students AI Literacy training licenses and 100 Robotics Learning Kits powered by Jetson Nano. These new tools allow students to explore artificial intelligence and physical AI, develop technical skills, and bring their creative ideas to life.
The First Lady’s remarks, as prepared for delivery, are below.
North Carolina is the Definition of Resilience
Hello everyone and thank you for welcoming me back to North Carolina. It’s such an honor to meet the inspirational people from Ashe County and Mountain View Elementary School. I am so proud of you all.
To Dr. Cox, Mr. Graybeal, educators, students, administrators, and the brave families of Mountain View, thank you for welcoming me here today. Your story is incredible.
North Carolina is the definition of resilience.
Toughness in times of adversity is ingrained in the Tar Heel State’s character. It is easy to discover resilience within the courage of Ashe County’s families, the strength of this community, and the determination of its people to rise when needed.
Almost two years ago, Hurricane Helene hit North Carolina with incredible force. Record-breaking rainfall led your state legislature to describe it as “multiple 1,000-year flood events.” Hundreds of roads and bridges were damaged or destroyed. Over one million people lost power, and many neighborhoods lost water, communications, and other vital services. Including, Ashe County.
Tragically, 108 lives were lost.
For children here at Mountain View Elementary, the storm took away much more than just your daily routine. Your neighborhood was flooded and your school was transformed into a distribution center. For too many kids across the state, the familiar daily routines of classrooms, teachers, and friends were suddenly gone.
But, as the water levels rose, you stepped up for one another. Families welcomed others into their homes, brave individuals rushed toward the danger to assist, and faith leaders gave comfort.
Teachers became anchors of stability, and your school turned into more than a place to learn. It turned into a lifeline, providing food, water, supplies, counseling, and hope.
Mountain View’s Assistant Principal Cynthia Harless is an American hero. When Hurricane Helene struck, Cynthia drove to check on the school. Soon thereafter, floodwaters washed away the roads, leaving Cynthia and her family unable to return home. Rather than focus ...

On Wednesday, September 16, 2026, the President signed into law:
S. 32, the “Local Access to Courts Act,” which adds College Station, Texas, and El Centro, California, to the list of locations where court is authorized to be held in the Southern District of Texas and in the Southern District of California, respectively; and
S. 307, the “Prison Staff safety Enhancement Act,” which establishes requirements for the Bureau of Prisons within the Department of Justice to address sexual harassment and sexual assault on Bureau of Prisons staff by incarcerated individuals.

Briefings & Statements
The White HouseSeptember 17, 2026
During National Hispanic Heritage Month, we honor the innumerable achievements and vast contributions of Hispanic Americans, whose strength, character, and devotion to our country continue to make America the greatest and most prosperous Nation in the world.
For centuries, Hispanic Americans have shaped the fabric of our culture, strengthened our most cherished institutions, and advanced the promise of the American Dream. They have fought to defend our freedom in the United States Armed Forces; protected our streets and cities by serving as law enforcement; cared for the vulnerable as doctors, nurses, and healthcare workers; strengthened our communities as clergy and religious leaders; and helped forge the destiny of our Republic by serving at the highest levels of government. In every profession throughout our land, they make our country stronger, wealthier, and prouder with each passing generation.
Above all, Hispanic Americans have immeasurably enriched our communities through a tireless dedication to hard work, an immense love of family, and an unshakable faith in Almighty God. My Administration reaffirms our unwavering commitment to defending these enduring values of faith, family, and freedom, and we remain steadfast in our mission to unleash the full potential of a stronger Nation so that every citizen has the opportunity to thrive, prosper, and achieve the American Dream. Through The Working Families Tax Cuts Act, we are helping Americans keep more of what they earn by delivering no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and no tax on Social Security, increasing the child tax credit, and creating a brand new investment account for American children – Trump Accounts. This historic legislation lowers taxes like never before for our workers, seniors, and entrepreneurs, rewarding the labor that built our economy and drives it forward.
As our Nation marks National Hispanic Heritage Month, we will continue to deliver historic wins, honor the rich culture and contributions of the Hispanic American community, and write the next chapter of our great American story. The courage, sacrifice, and perseverance of Hispanic Americans embody the very best of our Republic, and together, we will press forward with confidence, certain that our brightest days are yet to come.

item.description:

Briefings & Statements
The White HouseSeptember 18, 2026
Today, on the 79th birthday of the United States Air Force, I join a grateful Nation in honoring America’s airmen—past and present—for defending our liberty, safeguarding our way of life, and ruling the sky and space with exceptional professionalism and valor.
On September 18, 1947, the Air Force was born as an independent branch of the military charged with winning command of the air for America. Every day since, air power has kept our country secure, at peace, and prosperous, and when war has come, it has answered with swift and devastating force.
From the beginning, airmen have stood as our Nation’s sentries, avengers, and protectors of freedom, carrying out every mission with overwhelming power and precision, whether performing search and rescue missions, delivering aid to those in need, ensuring the integrity of our nuclear deterrent, or holding the line against our enemies from the air. These patriots carry on a storied legacy of dreamers, pioneers, and visionaries who propelled our rise as a global superpower, and their ability to “Fly-Fight-Win…Airpower Anytime, Anywhere” flows from their unwavering commitment to the warrior ethos and the core values of integrity, selflessness, and excellence.
This summer, in the heart of our Nation’s capital, Air Force fighters, tankers, bomber formations, and elite demonstration teams thundered over the National Mall and the White House in celebration of 250 glorious years of American Independence. The pageantry and the sound of freedom turned eyes skyward in awe, wonder, patriotism, and pride, and the impressive display of our arsenal offered an inspiring glimpse of the real-world capability to deploy, defend, and dominate that the world witnessed this year during critical combat operations worldwide.
Our United States Air Force is unmatched in innovation and expertise, with assets and personnel that make our citizens proud and our enemies fearful. As Commander in Chief, I extend my deepest respect to the men and women who wear its uniform, and I pledge to always support them with every resource they need to fly, fight, and win for the American People. On this anniversary, may God bless our airmen and the spouses and families who stand alongside them in service to our great Nation.

The White HouseSeptember 20, 2026
On the holiest day of the Jewish calendar, I send my best wishes to the entire Jewish community for a blessed Yom Kippur.
As it is referred to in the Torah as the “Sabbath of Sabbaths,” Yom Kippur empowers those of the Jewish faith to renew their unwavering relationship with the Creator through fasting, prayer, and charity. As the High Holy Days come to a close, and the fate of the year ahead is inscribed and sealed, my Administration is resolved to defend every American’s sacred right to freedom of religion.
May the Almighty bless you all with renewed strength and abundant faith on this holy day, and may He continue to bless the United States of America.

item.description:

Briefings & Statements
The White HouseSeptember 21, 2026
For nearly two centuries, Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) have opened doors of opportunity, cultivated excellence, and prepared generations of hardworking black Americans to become leaders in every field of national life. During National Historically Black Colleges and Universities Week, we honor that legacy and the enduring contributions of these storied institutions to our communities, our culture, and our country.
Today, HBCUs are thriving as never before, home to nearly 300,000 students and producing the doctors, engineers, entrepreneurs, educators, and military officers who are lifting America to even greater heights. Throughout my first Administration, I took historic action to strengthen this legacy, expanding opportunity for HBCUs and their students. I was proud to sign the FUTURE Act into law, guaranteeing a permanent stream of investment in HBCUs and other minority-serving institutions; expand funding for scholarships and research; provide hundreds of millions of dollars in disaster relief to damaged campuses; and sign the HBCU PARTNERS Act to deepen cooperation between these institutions, the Federal Government, and the private sector. Together, these actions gave HBCUs greater stability, more resources, and new avenues to educate and prepare the next generation of American leaders.
Since returning to office, I have continued building on that record. In April 2025, I signed an Executive Order reestablishing the White House Initiative on HBCUs with a renewed focus on research, innovation, campus modernization, private-sector partnerships, and preparing students for careers in our Nation’s fastest-growing industries. Last year, my Administration also increased Department of Education support for HBCUs by nearly 50 percent, bringing total funding to more than $1.3 billion for fiscal year 2025. Under my leadership, we will continue to honor the proud history of our country’s HBCUs and ensure they remain strong and capable to educate the next generation of black Americans.
This week, we celebrate the students, faculty, alumni, and communities whose dedication has sustained HBCUs from their founding to this very day. These great American institutions demonstrate what is possible when talent is met with opportunity, hard work is rewarded, and excellence is expected. As we reflect on their remarkable history, my Administration remains committed to ensuring that HBCUs continue empowering Americans to develop their God-given talents, pursue the American Dream, and lead our Nation toward an even stronger, more prosperous, and more glorious future.

item.title: First Lady Melania Trump Releases Details Ahead of His Excellency Xi Jinping, President of The People’s Republic of China, and Madame Peng Liyuan’s Visit to The White House
item.description:
Office of the First LadyFirst Lady Melania Trump Releases Details Ahead of His Excellency Xi Jinping, President of The People’s Republic of China, and Madame Peng Liyuan’s Visit to The White HouseThe White HouseSeptember 21, 2026

Office of the First Lady
The White HouseSeptember 21, 2026
President Donald J. Trump and First Lady Melania Trump will welcome His Excellency Xi Jinping, President of the People’s Republic of China and Madame Peng Liyuan to the White House on Thursday, September 24, 2026, for an official state visit. This visit comes more than a decade since President Xi and Madame Peng’s last visit to the White House, marking a significant milestone in the relationship between the two countries.
On Wednesday, September 23, the President will greet His Excellency, Xi Jinping, President of the People’s Republic of China and Madame Peng Liyuan at Joint Base Andrews.
On Thursday morning, September 24, the President and First Lady will host a State Arrival Ceremony honoring His Excellency, Xi Jinping, President of the People’s Republic of China and Madame Peng Liyuan. The ceremony, which will be held on the South Lawn, State Floor, and Rose Garden of the White House, will feature 479 military personnel, representing all branches of the United States Armed Forces.
As the arrival begins, the South Drive will be lined with the Armed Forces Full Honor Cordon leading to a national flag display of U.S. and China flags where the United States Army Herald Trumpets will present a fanfare on the South Portico as the President and First Lady welcome His Excellency Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan to the White House.
On the State Floor, “The President’s Own” United States Marine Band will play the national anthems of the People’s Republic of China and the United States of America, followed by remarks from both The President and His Excellency Xi Jinping.
The ceremony will also feature a Presidential Salute from the United States Marine Silent Drill Platoon and United States Joint Forces Command on the South Lawn. There will then be a Military Review in the Rose Garden where The United States Army Herald Trumpets will line the roof of the West and Oval Colonnades. Military demonstrations will be performed by the United States Army Old Guard Fife and Drum Corps, the United States Marine Corps Silent Drill Platoon, and “The Commandant’s Own” United States Marine Drum and Bugle Corps. The ceremony will conclude with a military flyover featuring a B-2 Spirit and four F-22 Raptors.
After the arrival ceremony, Mrs. Trump and Madame Peng Liyuan will visit the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art to explore works spanning centuries of artistic achievement and Sino-American cultural exchange.
On Thursday evening, the President and First Lady will greet His Excellency Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan upon their arrival to the North Portico of the White House for a State Dinner in the East Room. The Office of the First Lady will share additional details on the State Dinner on Wednesday, September 23.
On Friday morning, the President and First Lady will greet His Excellency Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan upon their arrival to the South Portico of the White House for tea in the Red Room of the White House. Afterward, the couples will travel to the National Archives in Washington, DC where they will view a variety of important records and documents significant to the American and Chinese relationship throughout history. To conclude the historic State visit, the President and First Lady will bid farewell to His Excellency and Madame Peng Liyuan at the National Archives.

First Lady Melania Trump Unveils New Fostering the Future Together Technology Alliances, International Events, and Membership Expansion

Office of the First lady
The White HouseSeptember 22, 2026
First Lady Melania Trump today reconvened members of Fostering the Future Together during the 81st United Nations General Assembly.
The First Lady welcomed leaders from around the world, including representatives from the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, Republic of Korea, the Philippines, Poland, Ukraine, Türkiye, the United Arab Emirates, Panama, Canada, and other nations.
First Lady Melania Trump remarked, “Together, we are a beautiful range of cultures, languages, histories, and traditions. And yet, we stand unified around one everlasting truth: the future of our world will be determined by what we do for our children today.”
First Lady Melania Trump unveiled several upcoming Fostering the Future Together events for 2026:
“When nations speak with one voice, the world listens. Our collective influence is profound. Together, we can open doors, move markets, shape policy. And most importantly, we can change lives for the better,” First Lady Melania Trump said.
First Lady Melania Trump also announced new private-sector technology partnerships with Adobe, Amazon, Intel, Starlink, Google, and Zoom. Tim Cook, Executive Chairman of Apple and Enrique Lores, CEO of PayPal, also attended.
The First Lady welcomed new member nations, expanding Fostering the Future Together to fifty-seven participating countries.
Calling on the assembled First Spouses to act, First Lady Melania Trump said, “Our Fostering the Future Together coalition must strive to empower the youth of our nations to: bend the boundaries of imagination, explore new frontiers of intellect, have the courage to take calculated risks, and build toward advancement of society.”
About Fostering the Future Together:Fostering the Future Together is a global coalition of nations unified to empower children through technology and education.
First Lady Melania Trump announced Fostering the Future Together during the 80th United Nations General Assembly. In spring 2026, she convened the initiative’s two-day Global Coalition Summit in Washington DC, bringing together First Spouses and technology-sector leaders at the United States Department of State. The gathering culminated at the White House, where the First Lady welcomed the largest assembly of First Spouses ever convened there for diplomatic purposes in U.S. history.
The First Lady’s remarks, as prepared for delivery, are below.
Fostering the Future Together Expands Nation Memberships, Private-Sector Commitments, & Unveils New Events
Thank you, Special Envoy Wallace and Ambassador Waltz. Your ongoing commitment to support Fostering the Future Together is both important and meaningful.
Friends, Excellencies, and Distinguished Leaders. Welcome to New York City.
Fostering the Future Together now unites nearly 60 nations, many represented here today. You have traveled great distances in support of our children, bringing together distinguished leaders from Panama, the Republic of Korea, Kenya, Albania, Estonia, Dominican Republic, Guatemala and beyond.
Together, we are a beautiful range of cultures, languages, histories, and traditions.
And yet, we stand unified around one everlasting truth: the future of our world will be determined by what we do for our children today.
Fostering the Future Together is more than a coalition. It is a commitment to empower children through technology and education, to ensure that every child, regardless of where they are born, has the opportunity to imagine, learn, create, and thrive.
When nations speak with one voice, the world listens. Our collective influence is profound. Together, we can open doors, move markets, shape policy. And most importantly, we can change lives for the better.
Each of us has been entrusted with the responsibility of leadership.
But mark my words, our success will not be measured solely by what we accomplish during our time in this role. Our success as leaders will be measured by what remains after we are gone.
Did we strengthen our schools? Did we make new discoveries possible? Did we inspire greater innovation?
And most importantly, will the next generation be able to build upon our vision and use our accomplishments to advance their careers, families, communities, and nations?
So, I ask you: Will you join me and lead? Will you put the future of our children above the difference...
